excerpt.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
excerpt.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

sections.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
sections.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

texts.zh:
我们实在是很难说[From.Planet.GetName]到底算不算作一个行星：初步钻探发现的是一层又一层的生物组织。据估计，总共需要2,435,463只缇扬奇尸体才能产生此等规模的行星质量（误差范围5.3%）。即使我们假设地核是一块岩石，尸体只是堆叠在上面，涉及到的样本数量依然是无比庞大的。

是某人或者某种事物将缇扬奇带到这里让它们死去，还是说它们只是顺其自然地来到这里度过最后的时光，然后死去？
texts.en:
It's hard to determine if [From.Planet.GetName] is even a planet: preliminary drilling has only revealed strata upon strata of biological tissue. According to estimations, it would take 2,435,463 Tiyanki bodies to produce a planetary mass of this size (with a margin of error equal to 5.3%). Even assuming the existence of a rocky core upon which the corpses are layered, the number of specimens involved is still significant.

Did someone or something bring the Tiyanki here to die, or are they naturally drawn to this place as their final hour draws near?

texts.zh:
我们实在是很难说[From.Planet.GetName]到底算不算作一个行星：初步钻探发现的是一层又一层的生物组织。据估计，总共需要2,435,463只缇扬奇尸体才能产生此等规模的行星质量（误差范围5.3%）。即使我们假设地核是一块岩石，尸体只是堆叠在上面，涉及到的样本数量依然是无比庞大的。

是某人或者某种事物将缇扬奇带到这里让它们死去，还是说它们只是顺其自然地来到这里度过最后的时光，然后死去？最重要的是：为什么我们的死灵法师不能复活它们？为什么这堆死去的肉体拒绝我们，就好像已经有其他存在在控制它们一样？
texts.en:
It's hard to determine if [From.Planet.GetName] is even a planet: preliminary drilling has only revealed strata upon strata of biological tissue. According to estimations, it would take 2,435,463 Tiyanki bodies to produce a planetary mass of this size (with a margin of error equal to 5.3%). Even assuming the existence of a rocky core upon which the corpses are layered, the number of specimens involved is still significant.

Did someone or something bring the Tiyanki here to die, or are they naturally drawn to this place as their final hour draws near? Most crucially: why are our Necromancers unable to revive them? Why does this dead flesh reject us, as if already controlled by another entity?

texts.zh:
遍布[From.Planet.GetName]地表的死亡缇扬奇的那种不寻常……的活动，似乎是它们再生能力的一种副作用：即使技术上已经判定为死亡，它们的尸体仍旧在不断地重组再生。这个恒星系拥有着非比寻常般丰富的营养物质，尤其是缇扬奇游荡的那个气态巨行星。或许这解释了为什么我们之前从未观察到这样的行为。

然而，这个发现并没有解释为什么这些死去的生物像是在被某种单一思维控制一样蠕动，不断地伸出触手，吞食新近降落到这个行星上的尸体。

我们希望进一步的挖掘能够揭示这个地方，或这个生命……的内在运作规律，带给我们新的见解。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]还在就术语和分类问题无法达成一致。
texts.en:
The unusual... liveliness of the dead Tiyanki covering the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] seems to be a byproduct of their regenerative capabilities: even if technically dead, the bodies are still reassembling themselves. This system is unusually rich in nourishing substances typically found in the gas giants where Tiyanki graze. Perhaps that explains why this behavior hasn't been observed before.

This discovery does not explain why the dead seem to move as if controlled by a single mind, extending their tentacles to encroach upon the new carcasses falling on the planet.

Further excavations will hopefully reveal new insights on the inner workings of this... place. Or being. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are still divided on the exact nomenclature.

texts.zh: 我们的挖掘队发掘到了一个复杂的隧道网络，从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表一直延伸到地下深处。化学分析确认迷宫的墙体是由压实的缇扬奇组织构成，尽管其年代甚至超过了我们的帝国，但肉质还散发着温热，甚至几乎没有腐败。看上去就像是这些尸体自己聚合到了一起，重构其形态建立了这个地方……但是为什么？
texts.en: Our excavations unearthed a complex network of tunnels extending under the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Chemical analysis confirms the walls are entirely composed of highly compressed Tiyanki tissue, the flesh still warm and hardly decomposed despite rivaling the age of our empire. It's as if the corpses were fused together, reshaped and modified to form this place... But why?

texts.zh:
在对[From.Planet.GetName]的地下隧道网络进行测绘的时候，我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]突然意识到，这个隧道网络同一只缇扬奇的血管系统极其相似——但是其规模达到了行星级别。

那些搏动的墙壁散发着轻微的温暖，随着探险队逐渐接近行星的核心，墙壁的温度也在慢慢提升——在核心处，我们的扫描仪捕捉到了一个微弱的生命信号。
texts.en:
After mapping the extensive underground network of [From.Planet.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] realized the tunnels closely match the structure of the Tiyanki vascular system - but on a planetary scale.

The pulsating walls emanate a soft warmth, the temperature slowly increasing as the expedition approached the planet core - where our scanners have picked up a faint life signal.

texts.zh:
在对[From.Planet.GetName]的地下隧道网络进行测绘的时候，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]突然意识到，这个隧道网络同一只缇扬奇的血管系统极其相似——但是其规模跟我们之前遇到的那只在星辰间游荡的缇扬奇族母差不多。

那些搏动的墙壁散发着轻微的温暖，随着探险队逐渐接近行星的核心，墙壁的温度也在慢慢提升——在核心处，我们的扫描仪捕捉到了一个微弱的生命信号。
texts.en:
After mapping the extensive underground network of [From.Planet.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] realized the tunnels closely match the structure of the Tiyanki vascular system - but on a scale comparable to that of the Tiyanki Matriarch we encountered while roaming the stars.

The pulsating walls emanate a soft warmth, the temperature slowly increasing as the expedition approached the planet core - where our scanners have picked up a faint life signal.

texts.zh:
在一个庞大的地下穴室中，一只缇扬奇竖立地站着，钟型的脑袋微微地摇晃着，它细线一样的触手舒展开来，连接着穴室的外墙。看上去它成为了某种控制单元，不断操纵、指引着这个行星级别墓地的生长。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]没法断定什么种类的生物会从如此恐怖的过程中诞生，但是当它苏醒的时候，有一件事是很明确的：它会成为远比普通的缇扬奇要大得多，也恐怖得多的存在。
texts.en:
In a vast underground chamber, a Tiyanki stands upright, bell-shaped head swaying lightly, its wiry tentacles spread across the floor to connect with the outer walls of the chamber. It appears to be some sort of command unit, controlling and directing the growth of this planet-sized graveyard.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are unable to determine what kind of creature will arise from this grim process, and when it will awaken, but one thing is for sure: it will be something far, far more vast and terrible than an ordinary Tiyanki.

在一个庞大的地下穴室中，一只缇扬奇竖立地站着，钟型的脑袋微微地摇晃着，它细线一样的触手舒展开来，连接着穴室的外墙。看上去它成为了某种控制单元，不断操纵、指引着这个行星级别墓地的生长。

我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]没法断定这个过程什么时候会完成，但是相信一旦这只生物苏醒，它会成为远比普通的缇扬奇要大得多，也恐怖得多的存在：这只生物值得我们视作一只新的缇扬奇族母。
texts.en:
In a vast underground chamber, a Tiyanki stands upright, bell-shaped head swaying lightly, its wiry tentacles spread across the floor to connect with the outer walls of the chamber. It appears to be some sort of command unit, controlling and directing the growth of this planet-sized graveyard.

Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] don't know when the process will be concluded, but believe once the creature awakens, it will be something far, far more vast and terrible than an ordinary Tiyanki: something worthy of being called a new Tiyanki Matriarch.

label.zh: 在不伤害它的前提下监视其生长。
label.en: Monitor its growth without harming it.

label.zh: 让这个神圣的生命体在和平中成长吧。
label.en: Let this sacred life-form growth in peace.

label.zh: 策展人肯定愿意为这个标本付个好价钱。
label.en: The Curators will pay a good price for this specimen.

texts.zh: 在一个庞大的地下穴室中，一只缇扬奇竖立地站着，钟型的脑袋微微地摇晃着，它细线一样的触手舒展开来，连接着穴室的外墙。看上去它成为了某种控制单元，不断操纵、指引着这个行星级别墓地的生长。但是这个生物现在已经死了，被我们用来前往这个地方的挖掘设备毁灭了。核心周边的外壳变得苍白而易碎，整个地方经历了第二次死亡。
texts.en: In a vast underground chamber, a Tiyanki stands upright, bell swaying lightly, its wiry tentacles spread on the floor to connect with the outer walls of the chamber. It appeared to be some sort of control unit, controlling and directing the growth of the grave mound. But the creature is now dead, destroyed by the mining equipment we used to get access to this same place. The shells around the core are pallid and brittle; soon, this whole place will die a second death.
